title: Early bands' musicianship and rough jobs
summary: Early musicians were not accomplished, and he hints at rough stories not for tape.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Bands today? No, no, they didn't sound like the bands today because mostly of them, to tell you the truth, they were not accomplished musicians.

There's many things that I went through that naturally you couldn't put on tape because you never played in front of women. But I'm telling you, I played with some rough elements there, I'm telling you. Especially with that Jack Reed song, that Patrick. Oh, you ain't got that on, eh?
Oh, yeah, well you don't have to, you said you weren't going to tell it before it went on anyway. You want to take it off and you tell us something and turn it off.
